per_task.question: In the five-year follow-up of ZUMA-1 (axicabtagene ciloleucel in refractory large B-cell lymphoma), how many of the patients with lymphoma in the bone marrow had disease progression by the data cutoff?
per_task.answer: In the five‑year ZUMA‑1 analysis, 8 patients had lymphoma detectable in the bone marrow at baseline, and 5 of them (62.5 %) experienced disease progression by the data‑cutoff date[PMID:36821768].

per_task.question: What proportion of patients develop cytokine release syndrome after CAR T-cell therapy?
per_task.answer: Approximately all patients receiving CAR T‑cell therapy develop cytokine release syndrome (CRS).
